prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: independent full-width city photograph for a bright, modern Chinese enterprise website hero and footer banner; this is a photographic background asset, not a page mockup.
Primary request: a beautiful, convincingly photographic panoramic view of Suzhou Jinji Lake and the contemporary lakeside city skyline in natural daylight. The recognizable Gate of the Orient (Dongfangzhimen) twin-tower arch should appear in the RIGHT half, with plausible nearby glass high-rises. Calm pale blue lake water in the foreground; a tree-lined curved lakeside road may occupy the lower far-right edge.
Composition: very wide landscape banner, approximately 1800 pixels wide by 650 pixels tall, aspect ratio about 2.77:1. The skyline, architecture, leafy lake shore, and road are concentrated from center-right to the far right. Keep the left 45% open and visually quiet with generous pale-blue sky and lake surface so dark webpage copy can be overlaid. Horizon near the lower half. Use a mildly elevated shoreline vantage with a natural perspective; do not exaggerate skyscrapers or make the city geometrically futuristic. The skyline remains comfortably below the top edge and clear in a short banner crop.
Style: realistic professional architectural landscape photography, fine natural glass detail, plausible distances and scale, gentle atmospheric depth; crisp but not oversharpened. Natural late-morning summer daylight, bright and airy, soft scattered white clouds, clear lake-blue and green colors, restrained saturation.
Constraints: image alone. Absolutely no text, slogans, labels, logotypes, signage readable as text, watermarks, drones, aircraft, futuristic holograms, charts, bounding boxes, map lines, UI, graphic overlays, borders, layouts, or gradients applied over the photograph. Avoid illustrated, 3D-rendered, fantasy or synthetic-looking aesthetics. Buildings should be credible, with the recognizable real Suzhou landmark represented without fanciful duplication.
limitations: AI-generated photographic illustration of Suzhou Jinji Lake; not an on-site documentary photograph or verified accurate geographic representation. Image contains no interface or UAV overlay. Header/footer CSS cropping may omit some skyline on mobile.
